gaps.subject: webpack 5.97.1 custom config (webpack.config.js) with React 18.3.1
gaps.detail: Not in the Alpha 1 qualified host matrix (Vite 8.3.1, Next.js 16.3.8, Rsbuild 2.2.11/Rspack 2.2.8).

gaps.subject: PandamStyle Alpha 1 webpack host integration
gaps.detail: No @pandamstyle webpack integration is qualified for a plain webpack project; the only webpack path is @pandamstyle/next.

gaps.subject: design-system tokens, themes, recipes and patterns
gaps.detail: None exist; only one SCSS variable ($danger) in src/styles/main.scss. A PandamStyle definition would need project-specific vocabulary that the install contract forbids inventing.

gaps.subject: whether to migrate the bundler to a qualified host
gaps.detail: Adopting PandamStyle requires moving from webpack to Vite or Rsbuild, which is a migration decision for the user.
